data.narrative:
Orbital Composites is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Cole Nielsen and Amolak Badesha. The company has raised $6.6M to date. The valuation framework drew on a comparable universe of 9 private robotics firms (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public peer (ticker 277810.KQ), though the broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector contains 10 same-sector peers.

A Peer-Median approach was inapplicable due to insufficient clustering: while 10 same-sector peers exist, fewer than three met narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier positioning. The analysis therefore relies on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions. Using $2M as a proxy for total raised and applying this multiplier yields an implied valuation of $6M.

The triangulated range spans $5M (low) to $7M (high), with a median of $6M, derived from a single applicable method. This narrow methodological base reflects data constraints rather than convergence across independent approaches. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific sector and stage cohort, and the absence of validated peer-level valuation benchmarks. Any revision should await richer comparable data or demonstrated unit economics.
